notes.title: Artemis Book Two - Now Available
notes.content:
Book Two is now available to purchase!


Book Two currently features Chapters 5 and 6



Chapter 7 is currently in development and will be updated when completed. 8 will follow after when development is complete for that chapter as well.



Chapters 5 & 6 features:

10,199 story renders

276 VFX and animations

135 New tracks

11 New SD Cards

7 New wallpapers for the phones.



See the main page for the bundle price
